raw_text: The fabricated Kashmir atrocity videos circulating today follow a well-documented pattern. Syrian conflict footage dubbed with Kashmiri audio, Myanmar violence repackaged with Kashmir captions, all metadata stripped. Pakistani accounts coordinate the release annually around August 5. This is industrial-scale atrocity propaganda designed to internationalize the Kashmir dispute.
